title: Policy Decision (v1)
description: Decision object returned by policy evaluation. Matches the Tier-1 minimum decision response (docs/agentic-aiops-platform/policy-specification.md). approval_tier and conditions are reserved for a future schema revision.

decision.description: Final outcome. deny is the default when no rule matches.

matched_rule_ids.description: Identifiers of the rules that matched the request. Empty when denied by default.

subject.description: The principal subject the decision applies to.
